title: Frozen sampled-policy evaluation diagnostic
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The sampled policies optimized during training may improve distributionally even when greedy argmax changes little; a CRN-aligned sampled evaluator will reveal whether the prior greedy-only curves missed general learned-weight gains.
material_change: Add an opt-in sampled-both-sides mode to the frozen mirrored evaluator, preserving greedy default and old artifacts. Use deterministic independent action uniforms indexed by evaluation seed, deal pair, physical seat, and per-seat decision count; preserve identical-policy mirror cancellation and paired treatment-control alignment.
baseline: Frozen Standard10 and untouched adaptive-league-all-heads-pilot-20260830 iter64; paired-seat-average-actor-pilot-20260830 iter64 is the treatment.
source: Existing frozen checkpoints only; no training or weight changes.

notes: Fail closed on unit/reproducibility tests or nonzero identical-policy sampled mirror result. Evaluate source Standard10, untouched all-heads iter64, and paired actor iter64 against the same three frozen anchors, sampled on both sides, using the same action/deal random coordinates. Preserve every old greedy artifact. Primary comparison is learned candidate minus source; secondary is paired actor minus untouched all-heads control. Confirm only a candidate with all three point-positive deltas and at least one positive paired-CI lower bound on an independent seed; otherwise reject mode mismatch as the current explanation.

Six new evaluator tests and five existing paired-return tests passed. Greedy defaults and legacy missing action_rng metadata remain compatible; sampled comparisons reject mismatched RNG schema/anchor action streams.

The final evaluation_code snapshot captures the evaluator actually used; initial snapshot retained. Final patch SHA256 d70296d88ea9b55b7fa69802a0d8f02a59f77228c51f9989b8fec3b28525212a. All frozen model hashes were rechecked unchanged after the matrix.

Read-only trainer inspection found a legacy training-hand accounting gap: total_hands counts only transition-bearing hands and omits no-decision hero hands. This does not affect frozen evaluation outcomes but must be repaired before further training/scaling.

result.summary: A tested sampled-both-sides evaluator completed 73,856 frozen internal hands with exact self-match cancellation and unchanged checkpoint hashes; neither learned candidate met the preregistered cross-anchor confirmation condition.
result.conclusion: No confirmable general learned-weight gain was hidden by the prior greedy-only evaluator at this sample size. Small sampled gains remain statistically unresolved; the single secondary slumbot_free positive interval is not a cross-anchor improvement.
result.next_step: Audit and repair physical-environment versus transition-bearing hand accounting while preserving legacy checkpoint counters and resume semantics before starting more training.
